Swiss Army Bench 0.0.23: the server stops when you close the app.

- **Closing Swiss Army Bench stops its server again.** In 0.0.22 every click in a window counted as the agent's
  kind of work, so the server stayed up for 10 minutes after you closed the app. Now only the agent, VS Code and
  `sab.push()` hold it after the last window closes; the app's own pages and its "is it running" checks do not.
